d.seg: बोलते हैं कि आप व्हाट्सअप दीजिए मैंने कहा देखिए ये काम मैं नहीं करती हूँ व्हाट्सअप व्हाट्सअप ना मैं नंबर देती हूँ ना कुछ
d.tr: They say give me your WhatsApp. I said look, I don't do this work. I don't give my WhatsApp number or anything.
d.ctx: The expert is describing how other users ask for her WhatsApp number and how she refuses them.
d.j: The speaker is reporting a past interaction where someone asked for her WhatsApp, and she is explicitly stating she refuses to do so.

d.seg: तुम अपना व्हाट्सअप नंबर दे दो व्हाट्सअप नंबर या कॉल करने के लिए ताकि मैं खुद तुमको कॉल करके बात करूँ
d.tr: Give me your WhatsApp number, WhatsApp number or for calling so that I can call you myself and talk.
d.ctx: The expert is telling a story about a previous caller she felt sorry for, and she is quoting what she said to him at that time.
d.j: The speaker is quoting her own past words where she offered her WhatsApp number to another user.

d.seg: चार पाँच तो ऐसी हैं जिनका मेरा जिनको मैंने अपना व्हाट्सएप नंबर देकर रखा हूँ
d.tr: There are four or five such people to whom I have given my WhatsApp number.
d.ctx: The user is telling the expert about his experience on the app and how he has shared his number with other users.
d.j: The speaker is reporting his past actions of sharing his WhatsApp number with other users on the platform.
